tagline: Recover the Past. Rebuild the Future.

assets.title: Robot Power On

assets.title: Knowledge Points Earned
assets.description: Light crystalline tally chime.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Knowledge points increment on HUD.

assets.title: Scientific Archive Completed
assets.description: Noble four-note scientific fanfare chime for 100% archive completion.
assets.intendedGameEvent: All records in an archive category completed.

assets.title: Mission Accepted
assets.description: Crisp ARES mission confirmation triad.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player accepts recovery assignment.

assets.title: Mission Deployment
assets.description: Telemetry countdown lock transitioning into upward deployment tone.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Rover deploys onto Martian landing zone.

assets.title: Location Arrival
assets.description: Atmospheric two-note harmonic beacon signaling site arrival.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Entering Chryse, Elysium, or Jezero landing site.

assets.title: Objective Updated
assets.description: Clean two-tone HUD objective refresh.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Active mission objective advances.

assets.title: Artifact Discovered
assets.description: Reverent vintage harmonic discovery swell.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player reaches historic NASA lander or probe.

assets.title: Recovery Successful
assets.description: Warm triumphant scientific triad confirming recovery goal.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Primary artifact stabilized or recovered.

assets.title: Mission Completed
assets.description: Dignified 5-note ARES mission-complete chime.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Mission summary screen triggered.

assets.title: Mission Failed
assets.description: Somber descending minor telemetry cadence.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Mission terminated due to critical failure.

assets.title: Mission Report Generated
assets.description: Brief teletype telemetry cascade concluding with archival chime.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Debrief report compiles on screen.

assets.title: New Mission Unlocked
assets.description: Bright rising fifth unlocking next Martian sector.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Next mission site unlocked on orbital map.

assets.title: Return to Headquarters
assets.description: Steady homing beacon pulse and warm sign-off chord.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player exits field site back to ARES HQ.

assets.title: New Knowledge Available
assets.description: Subtle bright chime alerting player to new dossier entry.
assets.intendedGameEvent: New encyclopedia/archive article unlocked.

assets.title: Battery Low
assets.description: Clean dual amber telemetry caution beep.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Battery drops below 25%.

assets.title: Battery Critical
assets.description: Urgent quadruple falling telemetry alarm.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Battery drops below 10%.

assets.title: Battery Charging
assets.description: Warm rising harmonic capacitor charge sweep.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Solar panels or charging station begins replenishing battery.

assets.title: Battery Fully Charged
assets.description: Crisp full-charge completion chord.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Battery reaches 100%.

assets.title: Structural Damage
assets.description: Damped metallic crunch followed by diagnostic fault ping.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Rover hull takes impact or hazard damage.

assets.title: Critical System Warning
assets.description: High-priority three-pulse ARES hazard beacon.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Major subsystem reaches critical state.

assets.title: Tool Damage
assets.description: Sharp mechanical shear click with brief warning tone.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Attached manipulator tool suffers wear or misalignment.

assets.title: Storage Almost Full
assets.description: Soft ascending-then-halting double buffer alert.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Sample or data buffer crosses 85% capacity.

assets.title: Storage Full
assets.description: Firm double low-mid buffer lockout tone.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Cannot store additional samples until synced.

assets.title: Emergency Shutdown
assets.description: Multi-system breaker trip and rapid bus power bleed.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Emergency safety shutdown engaged.

assets.title: Communication Interference
assets.description: Dust-storm RF carrier flutter and brief squelch static.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Radio interference degrades robot-to-ARES telemetry link.

assets.title: Overheating Warning
assets.description: Thermal warning triad rising slightly in urgency.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Actuator or power core approaches thermal limit.

assets.title: Chryse Planitia — Light Martian Wind
assets.description: Subtle thin-atmosphere stereo wind sweeping softly across Chryse plain.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Primary background loop in Chryse Planitia.

assets.title: Chryse Planitia — Abandoned Lander Ambience
assets.description: Quiet open basin air accented by distant thermal metal creaks from Viking 1.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Background loop near the abandoned Viking 1 lander.

assets.title: Chryse Planitia — Subtle Dust Movement
assets.description: Delicate drifting dust grains over dry rocky basin.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Alternate ambient layer in Chryse Planitia.

assets.title: Elysium Planitia — Soft Martian Wind
assets.description: Calm low-pressure breeze drifting over flat equatorial plains.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Primary background loop in Elysium Planitia.

assets.title: Elysium Planitia — Low Environmental Rumble
assets.description: Subtle subsurface acoustic resonance and fine soil vibration.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Background loop near the InSight HP3 excavation zone.

assets.title: Elysium Planitia — Subtle Mechanical Vibrations
assets.description: Faint wind-excited solar-array hum and fine soil hiss.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Ambient loop beside dormant InSight lander.

assets.title: Jezero Crater — Open Martian Wind
assets.description: Airy stereo crater-rim breeze with gentle natural gusts.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Primary background loop in Jezero Crater.

assets.title: Jezero Crater — Sand Ripple & Dust Gusts
assets.description: Soft saltating sand grains whispering across Neretva Vallis dunes.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Ambient loop at Ingenuity final resting dune.

assets.title: Jezero Crater — Quiet Environmental Ambience
assets.description: Sparse isolated crater air for puzzle-focused moments.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Subtle quiet exploration ambience in Jezero.

assets.title: Item Collected
assets.description: Clean tactile grab + bright ascending two-note confirmation.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player collects a field component or tool.

assets.title: Evidence Added
assets.description: Warm archival ping logging new field evidence.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Evidence card added to mission notebook.

assets.title: Knowledge Points Earned
assets.description: Crisp three-note ascending harmonic chime.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player awarded scientific knowledge points.

assets.title: Upgrade Available
assets.description: Noticeable bright two-tone workshop notification.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Enough resources to unlock a rover upgrade.

assets.title: Upgrade Completed
assets.description: Mechanical wrench snap paired with uplifting resolution chord.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Rover subsystem upgrade installed.

assets.title: Checkpoint Saved
assets.description: Quiet unobtrusive two-note telemetry confirmation.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Auto-checkpoint triggered during exploration.

assets.title: Interaction Denied
assets.description: Short soft muted rejection tone.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Object is locked or out of reach.

assets.title: Optional Objective Completed
assets.description: Clean bonus chime rewarding extra scientific curiosity.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Bonus inspection or side goal completed.

assets.title: Achievement Unlocked
assets.description: Warm crystalline 4-note milestone arpeggio.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player unlocks a career milestone.

assets.title: Mission Exit Confirmed
assets.description: Clean descending sign-off confirming departure from field site.
assets.intendedGameEvent: Player confirms exiting mission zone.
